calibration.role: post-freeze arithmetic calibration/falsification only; not proof

exact_result.lemma: For the frozen C041 canonical grammar, H_13 is empty and P_14 is empty. Hence H_13 intersection P_14 is empty.
exact_result.length_formula: Let w=bit_length(v), b=bit_length(m). Before optional padding, B(v,m)=8+(2w-1)+(2b-1)+3m(w+1)=6+2w+2b+3m(w+1). The canonical even length is L=B+(B mod 2).
proof_26: If m=2, then b=2. For w=1, B=24 and L=24; for w>=2, B>=32. Thus L is not 26.
If m=1, then b=1 and B=11+5w. The even lengths for w=1,2,3 and w>=4 are 16,22,26 and at least 32, respectively. Therefore L=26 iff w=3, i.e. v in {4,5,6,7}.
Every one-clause CNF is satisfiable: choose an assignment satisfying any one literal in its sole nonempty three-literal clause. Hence no canonical UNSAT word has length 26, so H_13 is empty.
proof_28: If m>=3, the same lower bound gives B>=30>28.
If m=2, the only w=1 length is 24 and every w>=2 length is at least 32.
If m=1, the possible even lengths around 28 are 26 at w=3 and at least 32 at w>=4. Hence no canonical word has length 28, so P_14 is empty.
exact_result.scope_consequence: The k=13 literal-transpose collision route is vacuous before any suffix/prefix bit comparison. No statement is made for k>13, cover complexity, circuit lower bounds, or P versus NP.

falsifier: Any canonical C041 word of length 28; any canonical UNSAT C041 word of length 26; or an overlooked (v,m) case violating the displayed length bounds refutes the corresponding claim.

novelty_classification.defensibility: The local lemma composes the already-frozen encoding length law with the elementary satisfiability of one-clause CNF; no new external theorem is claimed.

source_boundary.downstream_primary_literature: Cavalar--Oliveira, Boolean Circuit Complexity and Two-Dimensional Cover Problems (2025), used only to preserve the cover-complexity consumer boundary; this local encoding lemma does not claim a theorem from that paper.
